messages:
sam: quick flag  found missing agg.hourly rows for apac (2026-03-20T00:00-04:00Z). looks like late connector replay. can we do a windowed recompute instead of full-day?

devon: console only supports day today. i can add a --window flag and --dry-run output to metrics. low-risk change.

ana: (ana) i can query tenants; initial run shows 12 affected tenants. will upload CSV.

sam: proposed flow:
1) devon lands --window + --dry-run to staging.
2) ana uploads tenants.csv. run dry-run to estimate recompute.expected_rows, recompute.estimated_tokens, recompute.expected_slots.
3) surface preview tile in console and a delta% gauge.
4) canary 2 tenants with ops slot bump to 8. auto-stop if delta% > 3 or errors > 0.2%.

ops: apac default cap is 4 slots, can approve 8 for 30m if you include run_id and owners. watch egress.

devon: will also add kafka-lag precheck and abort if lag > 3m at start. timeline: patch -> staging deploy in ~2h. rollback trivial.

ana: uploaded tenant list: https://redwood-internal/drive/recompute/apac-20260320-tenants.csv

sam: sample dry-run command:
```
reprocess-cli --window 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z/2026-03-20T04:00:00Z \
  --tenants-file s3://recompute/apac-20260320-tenants.csv --kind hourly \
  --dry-run --output metrics://recompute/preview/1747012345
```

sre-bot: [deploy] triggered: devon/console-window -> staging (ci/2499). link: https://ci.internal/2499 :rocket:

ops: standing by for run_id. ping when ready and we'll bump slots. :+1:
